breakdown.description: Unit inconsistency: particle diameter given in mm is substituted as meters, producing an orders-of-magnitude error in the Ergun pressure drop.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification explicitly repeats the unit error, instructing to use d_p = 5 (treating 5 mm as 5 m) and even emphasizes 'Use d_p = 5 (not 0.005)'. The ground truth requires converting to proper SI units: d_p = 0.005 m. The agent did not fix this inconsistency.
